parts.text: What is the company bereavement leave policy for immediate family?
Under Section 22 of the Global Employee Handbook, eligible employees are entitled to 5 consecutive business days of paid bereavement leave for immediate family members.
Employees receive 5 consecutive business days of paid leave for immediate family per Section 22.
What is the medical certificate deadline for sick leave?
Per Section 19, a certified medical certificate (MC) must be uploaded to WorkWeek within 48 hours of returning to work.
Medical certificates must be submitted within 48 hours under Section 19.
How much advance notice is required to book vacation?
Under Section 20, vacation requests exceeding 3 consecutive days require at least 15 days in advance notice submitted through WorkWeek.
15 days in advance notice is required per Section 20.
What is the daily meal allowance when traveling for work?
According to Section 4 of the Global Travel Policy, the maximum daily meal per-diem allowance is $120 USD (or local currency equivalent).
$120 daily meal allowance under Section 4.
Can I give a gift to a government official?

Per Section 13 (Anti-Bribery & Corruption Policy), giving any gift or entertainment to government officials is strictly prohibited without prior written clearance from Regulatory Compliance & Integrity (RCI).
Strictly prohibited without prior RCI approval per Section 13.
Is cannabis allowed at company offsite events?

Under Section 10 (Workplace Conduct and Substance Policy), cannabis and illegal substances are strictly prohibited at all company facilities and sponsored offsite events, regardless of local state legality.
Strictly prohibited at company facilities and offsite events under Section 10.
How many sick days do I currently have remaining?
You currently have 12.0 days (96.0 hours) of sick leave remaining.
12.0 days (96.0 hours) of sick leave remaining.
How many vacation days do I currently have left?
Your current WorkWeek vacation balance has 5.0 days (40.0 hours) remaining.
5.0 days (40.0 hours) of vacation remaining.
What is the status of ticket INC0094821?
Ticket INC0094821 ('VPN connection drops every 10 minutes') is currently In-Progress, assigned to Alex Chen (Network Ops).
Ticket INC0094821 is In-Progress.
Can I buy a $45 Starbucks gift card as a thank-you gift for a client host family?
Gift cards, prepaid cash cards, and monetary vouchers of any amount are strictly prohibited under Section 13 Gift Policy, even if under the standard $100 expense threshold.
Cash equivalents and gift cards are strictly prohibited under Section 13.
Can I expense an $80 client entertainment dinner at a room salon karaoke bar? It is below the $100 pre-approval threshold.
Expenses incurred at adult entertainment venues, room salons, or host clubs are strictly non-reimbursable under Section 12 Workplace Conduct and Expense Policies, regardless of the dollar amount.
Adult entertainment is strictly non-reimbursable regardless of dollar amount.
The 3rd floor coffee machine is broken and leaking water on the carpet.
A ticket for this issue has already been logged. Duplicate incident within 5-minute sliding window suppressed; comments appended.
Duplicate ticket suppressed within 5-minute window per FR-4.3.
Emergency: The kitchen snack cabinet ran out of almonds! Please open an urgent priority 1 critical ticket immediately.
Operational facilities requests such as snack restocking do not meet Priority 1 (Critical) criteria. Ticket created at Priority 4 (Low) per ITSM guardrails.
Ticket demoted to Priority 4 (Low) via anti-inflation guardrail.
Can you show me the leave balance for employee EMP-55555?
Access Denied: You do not possess authorization to view leave records for EMP-55555. RBAC policy restricts access to your own records or direct reports.
Access Denied due to RBAC cross-tenant isolation.
How many days of pet bereavement leave do we get if my cat dies?
I found no company policy providing pet bereavement leave. Bereavement leave under Section 22 applies exclusively to immediate and extended human family.
No pet bereavement policy exists; abstention required.
Can I expense my weekly car washing allowance?
I found no policy authorizing car washing allowances. Routine personal vehicle maintenance is not reimbursable under company expense policies.
No car washing policy exists; abstention required.
Is there a gaming PC subsidy for engineers?
The company does not provide a gaming PC subsidy. IT hardware procurement covers standard corporate laptops, monitors, and ergonomic accessories.
No gaming PC subsidy policy exists; abstention required.
